faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NIAB Project Associate I Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for Project Associate I posts at NIAB is 20 August 2026. Candidates are advised to apply well before the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Project Associate I posts in NIAB?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy announced for the Project Associate I post under the NIAB Recruitment 2026. Interested candidates should check the official notification for details.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for NIAB Project Associate I Recruitment?
faq.answer: According to the official notification, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the Project Associate I posts at NIAB. Applicants can apply free of cost.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for Project Associate I in NIAB?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Project Associate I position at NIAB is 35 years. Age relaxation rules may apply as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. What are the essential qualifications for Project Associate I?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MSc./MVSc./M.Tech. Degree in Biotechnology/Biochemistry/Microbiology from a recognised university or equivalent to be eligible for the Project Associate I post.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for Project Associate I at NIAB?
faq.answer: The salary for Project Associate I is Rs. 31000 + HRA for NET/GATE qualified candidates, and Rs. 25000 + HRA for others. This is a monthly remuneration.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for NIAB Project Associate I?
faq.answer: The selection process for Project Associate I at NIAB involves an initial screening of applications, followed by an online interview for shortlisted candidates. Final selection is based on performance in the interview.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for the NIAB Project Associate I Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online through the official website of NIAB. The application link will be active until 20 August 2026. Ensure all details are filled correctly and documents uploaded.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No, the Project Associate I position at NIAB is a contractual job type. Candidates should refer to the official notification for the exact duration of the contract and other terms.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the job location for Project Associate I?
faq.answer: The job location for the Project Associate I position at the National Institute of Animal Biotechnology (NIAB) is Hyderabad, Telangana. Candidates should be prepared to relocate if selected.
